facts.fact: The human resources minister launched Bayan, a national database of civil-service personnel records held by the Civil Service Diwan, covering every public employee from appointment to separation (date taken from the published date, 2026-08-06).
facts.system: Bayan digital platform for the civil service

facts.fact: Bayan was launched as a move from paper files to digital administration of civil-service personnel records (date taken from the published date, 2026-08-06).
facts.system: Bayan digital platform for the civil service

systems.system: Bayan digital platform for the civil service
systems.owner: Civil Service Diwan; built with the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications
